[[Risen Ashen Hulk]]s are [[titan]] necromancers that can either be found wandering the [[Ring of Fire Islands]] or emerging from the ashes of a [[Burning Titan]]'s remains. Similar to Burning Titans, people within adjacent range of one will be given the [[Burning]] condition. Risen Ashen Hulks are vulnerable to [[cold damage]] and will spawn a [[Hand of the Titans|Hand]] and a [[Fist of the Titans]] when killed.
